title: Cholera
definition: Cholera is an acute diarrheal infection caused by ingestion of food or water contaminated with the bacterium Vibrio cholerae.

title: Plague
definition: Plague is a disease that affects humans and other mammals. It is caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis.

title: Tularaemia
definition: Tularaemia is a disease caused by the bacterium Francisella tularensis.

title: Pulmonary tuberculosis
definition: Pulmonary tuberculosis is tuberculosis that affects the lungs.

title: Miliary tuberculosis
definition: Miliary tuberculosis is a form of tuberculosis that is characterized by a wide dissemination into the human body.

title: Malaria
definition: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease affecting humans and other animals.

title: Malaria due to Plasmodium falciparum
definition: Malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum, the most severe form of malaria.

title: Viral hepatitis A
definition: Hepatitis A is an infectious disease of the liver caused by hepatitis A virus.

title: Viral hepatitis B
definition: Hepatitis B is an infectious disease caused by the hepatitis B virus.

title: Viral hepatitis C
definition: Hepatitis C is an infectious disease caused by the hepatitis C virus.

title: Malignant neoplasm of lip
definition: Primary malignant neoplasm of the lip.

title: Malignant neoplasm of breast
definition: Primary malignant neoplasm arising in the breast.

title: Malignant neoplasm of cervix uteri
definition: Primary malignant neoplasm of the cervix uteri.

title: Malignant neoplasm of trachea, bronchus or lung
definition: Primary malignant neoplasm of the trachea, bronchus, or lung.

title: Malignant neoplasm of stomach
definition: Primary malignant neoplasm of the stomach.

title: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
definition: Type 1 diabetes mellitus is a form of diabetes mellitus that results from autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing beta cells of the pancreas.

title: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
definition: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is a metabolic disorder that is characterized by high blood glucose in the context of insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency.

title: Gestational diabetes mellitus
definition: Gestational diabetes mellitus is glucose intolerance with onset or first recognition during pregnancy.

title: Thyrotoxicosis
definition: Thyrotoxicosis is the condition that occurs due to excessive thyroid hormone of any cause.

title: Hypothyroidism
definition: Hypothyroidism is a condition in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone.

title: Single episode depressive disorder
definition: Single episode depressive disorder is characterized by the presence or history of one depressive episode.

title: Recurrent depressive disorder
definition: Recurrent depressive disorder is characterized by a history of at least two depressive episodes.

title: Generalized anxiety disorder
definition: Generalized anxiety disorder is characterized by marked symptoms of anxiety that persist for at least several months.

title: Panic disorder
definition: Panic disorder is characterized by recurrent unexpected panic attacks.

title: Schizophrenia
definition: Schizophrenia is characterized by disturbances in multiple mental modalities.

title: Essential hypertension
definition: Essential hypertension is high blood pressure that doesn't have a known secondary cause.

title: Hypertensive heart disease
definition: Hypertensive heart disease is heart disease caused by high blood pressure.

title: Acute myocardial infarction
definition: Acute myocardial infarction is the medical name for a heart attack.

title: Heart failure
definition: Heart failure is a condition in which the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs.

title: Stroke, not specified as haemorrhage or infarction
definition: Stroke of unspecified type.

title: Pneumonia
definition: Pneumonia is an inflammatory condition of the lung affecting primarily the small air sacs known as alveoli.

title: Asthma
definition: Asthma is a respiratory condition marked by attacks of spasm in the bronchi of the lungs.

title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
definition: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is a type of obstructive lung disease.

title: Traditional Medicine Pattern: Diabetes with Kidney Yang Deficiency
definition: A traditional medicine pattern characterized by diabetes mellitus with symptoms of kidney yang deficiency.

title: Traditional Medicine Pattern: Hypertension with Liver Yang Rising
definition: Traditional Chinese Medicine pattern of hypertension characterized by liver yang hyperactivity.

title: Ayurvedic Pattern: Madhumeha (Diabetes) - Vata-Kapha Type
definition: An Ayurvedic classification of diabetes characterized by Vata-Kapha dosha imbalance.

title: Ayurvedic Pattern: Rajayakshma (Tuberculosis) - Vataja Type
definition: Ayurvedic classification of tuberculosis as Rajayakshma with predominant Vata dosha involvement.

title: Unani Pattern: Ziabetus Shakari - Sanguine Temperament
definition: Unani medicine classification of diabetes associated with sanguine temperament.
